Description: As an Engineer, I want to log in so that my account is secure.
As an Admin, I want RBAC so that only authorized users can configure thresholds.
As a Machine, I want to send HMAC-signed telemetry so that data integrity is maintained.
As the System, I want to evaluate readings against thresholds so that anomalies are detected.
As an Engineer, I want to view active alerts so that I can monitor machine health.
As an Engineer, I want to acknowledge alerts so that others know I am working on it.
As an Admin, I want to configure thresholds so that anomaly detection is accurate.
As an Auditor, I want threshold changes audited so that there is a tamper-evident record.
As a Maintenance Supervisor, I want to schedule maintenance so that machines are serviced.
As the System, I want to write hash-chained logs so that tampering is detectable.
As the System, I want rate limiting on APIs so that DoS attacks are mitigated.
As the System, I want to reject malformed or NaN telemetry so that processing does not crash.
